answer: Issue each identity a fresh, unpredictable challenge every epoch, seeded by the previous emission hash so no farm can precompute answers. Picture a jetty built one plank per tide: work must be done now, in the open, not stockpiled. A spammer cloning accounts still owes original labor for each, and template reuse stands out like an umber stain on a clean terrace — machine-checked and rejected in replay.
